jobs.title: MECHANICAL MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR
jobs.description:
The Company

Imerys is the world’s leading supplier of mineral-based specialty solutions for the industry with €3.4 billion in revenue and 12,300 employees in 40 countries in 2025. The Group offers high value-added and functional solutions to a wide range of industries and fast-growing markets such as solutions for the energy transition and sustainable construction, as well as natural solutions for consumer goods. Imerys draws on its understanding of applications, technological knowledge, and expertise in material science to deliver solutions which contribute essential properties to customers’ products and their performance. As part of its commitment to responsible development, Imerys promotes environmentally friendly products and processes in addition to supporting its customers in their decarbonization efforts.
Imerys is listed on Euronext Paris (France) with the ticker symbol NK.PA.

The Position
MECHANICAL MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR

Job Summary
Riconosciuta a livello internazionale come leader di mercato, Imerys Graphite & Carbon serve svariati settori industriali in continua espansione come veicoli elettrici, polimeri, materiali ingegneristici e refrattari per costruzioni. Ricerca e innovazione sono i pilastri dell’offerta di soluzioni a base grafite e carbonio, sviluppate presso i nostri laboratori e prodotte presso i nostri stabilimenti dotati delle tecnologie più all’avanguardia.
Appartenente al solido Gruppo internazionale Imerys, la divisione Graphite & Carbon ha headquarter svizzero ed è presente a livello globale con svariate sedi commerciali e produttive.

Per lo storico stabilimento produttivo di Bodio , rinomato per la lavorazione della grafite da più di un secolo, si ricerca…

MECHANICAL MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità:

• Assicurare che i lavori di manutenzione preventiva, predittiva e le riparazioni siano eseguiti in modo sicuro, efficace e tempestivo per garantire l’affidabilità degli impianti.

• Gestire la manutenzione dell'intero parco impianti focalizzandosi specificamente sulla parte meccanica, garantendo un costante coordinamento e sinergia operativa con il supervisore dell'area elettrica.

• Coordinare, condurre e guidare il team di manutentori interni e supervisionare l'operato delle ditte esterne.

• Pianificare ed organizzare gli interventi dell’officina, definendo le priorità operative in stretta collaborazione con il supervisore dell'area elettrica, i capi fabbrica e la produzione.

• Gestire e aggiornare il piano annuale delle manutenzioni preventive e coordinare la pianificazione operativa in collaborazione con il pianificatore.

• Organizzare e pianificare i turni di picchetto per garantire l'assistenza tecnica fuori orario.

• Promuovere e garantire la sicurezza sul lavoro nel rispetto delle norme vigenti e delle direttive ambientali e 5S.

• Identificare i bisogni formativi della squadra, aggiornare la skill matrix e definire gli obiettivi annuali del personale condotto.

• Collaborare alla gestione del magazzino ricambi (registrazioni SAP) e verificare le fatture relative a prestazioni di terzi e forniture.

Cosa cerchiamo:

• Diploma STS/SUP/ETH o formazione tecnica equivalente in ambito meccanico con comprovata esperienza in un ruolo analogo all'interno di realtà industriali/strutturate.

• Esperienza consolidata nella manutenzione di impianti industriali.

• Comprovata esperienza nella conduzione e gestione di personale tecnico.

• Ottima padronanza dell'italiano; è richiesta una buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese.

• Buone competenze informatiche (MS Office, Google Workspace, SAP).

• Spiccate capacità organizzative, comunicative, di gestione delle priorità (multi-tasking) e di negoziazione.

• Flessibilità negli orari di lavoro e attitudine al lavoro di squadra e al miglioramento continuo.

In linea con i nostri valori offriamo un’atmosfera lavorativa attrattiva e dinamica in un ambiente multiculturale e internazionale con possibilità di formazione continua, crescita personale e professionale in tutti gli ambiti.
Applichiamo il Contratto Collettivo di Lavoro (CCL) dell’industria metalmeccanica ed elettrica che garantisce ai dipendenti condizioni di lavoro all’avanguardia e in continuo aggiornamento.
Inoltre, Imerys Graphite & Carbon è molto impegnata a tutelare la salute dei propri dipendenti offrendo una serie di iniziative volte a migliorare la sicurezza sul posto di lavoro e un sano equilibrio vita-lavoro.
L'azienda si dedica al miglioramento continuo delle proprie attività con una particolare attenzione alla sostenibilità per ridurre il proprio impatto ambientale offrendo ad esempio interessanti agevolazioni per gli abbonamenti dei mezzi pubblici con i quali è possibile raggiungere facilmente lo stabilimento di Bodio.

Position Type
Full time and
Permanent

Only technical issues will be monitored through the below inbox:
recruiting.support@ imerys.com

PLEASE DO NOT SUBMIT RESUMES OR APPLICATIONS TO THIS EMAIL, AS THEY WILL NOT BE REVIEWED.

To ensure fairness and legal compliance in our recruitment processes, only applications received through the online application process will be considered.

IMERYS is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and it is our policy to not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: HR Director IGC H/F
jobs.description:
The Company

Imerys is the world’s leading supplier of mineral-based specialty solutions for the industry with €3.4 billion in revenue and 12,300 employees in 40 countries in 2025. The Group offers high value-added and functional solutions to a wide range of industries and fast-growing markets such as solutions for the energy transition and sustainable construction, as well as natural solutions for consumer goods. As part of its commitment to responsible development, Imerys promotes environmentally friendly products and processes in addition to supporting its customers in their decarbonization efforts.
Imerys is listed on Euronext Paris (France) with the ticker symbol NK.PA.

The Position
HR Director IGC H/F

Job Summary
Job Purpose
As a key member of the Imerys Graphite & Carbon Leadership Team and the Human Resources Leadership Team you will act as the strategic architect of the people agenda for a fast growing ~250M industrial business.
This role is a "player-coach" position: you will drive high-level organizational design and engagement initiatives while ensuring operational HR excellence across a diverse geographical footprint, spanning Europe, North America, and APAC. (Belgium 170 employees, Switzerland 170 employees and the rest spread in Canada, China, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Korea, Republic, Malaysia, Netherlands, United States of America)

Reports To : Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO)
Dotted Line: Business Vice President Graphite & Carbon

jobs.description:
The Company

Imerys is the world’s leading supplier of mineral-based specialty solutions for the industry with €3.4 billion in revenue and 12,300 employees in 40 countries in 2025. The Group offers high value-added and functional solutions to a wide range of industries and fast-growing markets such as solutions for the energy transition and sustainable construction, as well as natural solutions for consumer goods. Imerys draws on its understanding of applications, technological knowledge, and expertise in material science to deliver solutions which contribute essential properties to customers’ products and their performance. As part of its commitment to responsible development, Imerys promotes environmentally friendly products and processes in addition to supporting its customers in their decarbonization efforts.
Imerys is listed on Euronext Paris (France) with the ticker symbol NK.PA.

The Position
Communication Manager

Job Summary
Key Responsibilities:
Act as a single and pivotal point of contact for all communication needs of the business - managing stakeholders internally and externally in close collaboration the Management team and the global organization

• Develop and implement the communications strategy (internally and externally) including messages, interviews, postings, , change management and tools for Imerys Graphite & Carbon in line with the Group framework.

• Organize, structure and manage communications resources within Imerys Graphite & Carbon and ensure cascading of information to all employees towards all facilities.

• Act as the focal point for managing press and crisis communication for the BA (following the Group’s crisis comms process).

• Develop, coordinate and implement when appropriate effective customer-related communication campaigns in collaboration with Marketing teams – including trade show and event organisation, advertising, literature, press relations, website management, surveys…

• Advise leaders and leadership team, while adhering to global communications practice standards – be part of the region decision making process, participating in appropriate leadership forums.

• Advise and supporting other departments (e.g. Sales, Business Development, R&D, Operations, Safety, etc.) on communication activities and campaigns

• Work closely with the Imerys Communication community to ensure coordination and alignment of messages and activities.

• Be accountable for IGC’s Management communication (quarterly leadership calls, communication packs, newsletters, global management forums etc.)

Qualification Requirements:

• Being a creative and self driven expert in all areas of communications scope:

• Corporate reputation

• Product communications / Operational marketing

• Internal communications

• Governance

• Deep understanding of relevant industry and business practices.

• Ability to think and act globally for the benefit of Imerys overall,

• Ability to interact with senior leaders and engage in high-level business focused discussions and decisions.

• Strong resource management and project management/coordination skills / people development skills.

• Think out of the box and being curious

Full time and
Permanent

The Position
Communication Manager

Job Summary
Key Responsibilities:
Act as a single and pivotal point of contact for all communication needs of the business - managing stakeholders internally and externally in close collaboration the Management team and the global organization

• Develop and implement the communications strategy (internally and externally) including messages, interviews, postings, , change management and tools for Imerys Graphite & Carbon in line with the Group framework.

• Organize, structure and manage communications resources within Imerys Graphite & Carbon and ensure cascading of information to all employees towards all facilities.

• Act as the focal point for managing press and crisis communication for the BA (following the Group’s crisis comms process).

• Develop, coordinate and implement when appropriate effective customer-related communication campaigns in collaboration with Marketing teams – including trade show and event organisation, advertising, literature, press relations, website management, surveys…

• Advise leaders and leadership team, while adhering to global communications practice standards – be part of the region decision making process, participating in appropriate leadership forums.

• Advise and supporting other departments (e.g. Sales, Business Development, R&D, Operations, Safety, etc.) on communication activities and campaigns

• Work closely with the Imerys Communication community to ensure coordination and alignment of messages and activities.

• Be accountable for IGC’s Management communication (quarterly leadership calls, communication packs, newsletters, global management forums etc.)

• Being a creative and self driven expert in all areas of communications scope:

• Corporate reputation

• Product communications / Operational marketing

• Internal communications

• Governance

• Deep understanding of relevant industry and business practices.

• Ability to think and act globally for the benefit of Imerys overall,

• Strong resource management and project management/coordination skills / people development skills.
